comparison: Both paths start from nearly identical two-phase `importContacts` implementations sharing identical `csv.js`, `email.js`, `store.js`, and `create.js`, and converge on the same change: wrapping the existing body in `processImport(text, store, apply)` and guarding only `store.rename` and `store.insert` with `apply`. Change locality and rule ownership are equally strong in both because `Map` deduplication by normalized email precedes all store access. Concrete differences are minor: `p01` retains a pre-existing extra `result.rows` array, stores `{ name, email }` in `contacts`, and asserts unchanged-name non-rename directly on both functions; `p02` stores `name`, returns strictly `{ created, updated, rejected }`, and freezes stored contact objects during preview testing.
